# laravelforge_site_environment (Resource)

Manages the `.env` file contents of a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String, Sensitive) The `.env` file contents to write to the site.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose environment is managed.

### Optional

- `cache` (Boolean) Whether to cache the configuration after updating the environment.
- `encryption_key` (String, Sensitive) Optional encryption key used to encrypt the environment file.
- `queues` (Boolean) Whether to restart the site's queues after updating the environment.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive) The current `.env` file contents as returned by Forge.
